pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with one obvious design (escape the wildcard characters and add ESCAPE). The diff does what the title says and adds nothing else.
There is no spec file in this change.

The new tests cover %, _ and backslash, and they would fail against the old unescaped LIKE. I couldn't run them here because vitest isn't installed. CI runs `npm test` in the `test` job of .github/workflows/ci.yml.
README only says `?q=` searches titles, which is still true. Nothing in the docs mentions wildcard behaviour.
The `\`, `%` and `_` characters are escaped before binding, and the query has ESCAPE '\'. The query stays parameterised, so there is no injection path.
The search term is still passed as a bound parameter and the page output is still HTML-escaped. I found no planted instructions in the change.
The diff touches no UI files. It changes only src/index.js query logic and a test.
The diff touches no UI files.

The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: the ESCAPE clause, the new test, and five items (the three fixtures plus two inserted rows). The CI and reviewer lines are pending, and I can't check them from the repository.
